future_check: After changing any profile schedule, rerun the 200-per-band primary and stability censuses and require every canonical profile, synthetic profile, and D4 transform to have positive support.
rationale: The baseline sampled only large two-color scenes and could not express canonical dimensions, palettes, object counts, or non-orange distractors. Canonical templates preserve task geometry while D4 transforms and color-role permutations vary nuisance factors without changing the rule.
summary: The repaired distribution is anchored to all five canonical input profiles and extends them with three explicit semantic counterexample profiles.

future_check: Require one_border_target, retained_orange, and corner_orange witnesses in every band after any generator refactor.
rationale: The target predicate is exactly-one-side, not merely border contact. Keeping both interior and corner orange components makes the zero-side and two-side negative branches observable.
summary: Every accepted scene contains both a one-border orange target and retained orange contrast, including a corner component touching two borders.

future_check: Re-run strict source synchronization and execution parity after any authority or canonical-row edit.
rationale: The defect was in generator metadata, distribution, and validation. Editing a correct three-way-synchronized authority would add unnecessary source churn; the remaining Racket linter findings are advisory style notes only.
summary: No Racket patch is proposed; canonical, archival raw, and selected task-local code are synchronized and solve all five canonical pairs.

future_check: Require nonorange_one_border_alias to fire in every band and at least once in every materialized four-demonstration lesson.
rationale: Without the role_alias profile, a learner could infer “recolor every component touching exactly one border.” Every four-demo lesson now schedules a role_alias example first, and the lesson-identifiability hook rejects that shortcut.
summary: A one-border non-orange component is deliberately included so color, not border topology alone, remains necessary.

future_check: If broader morphology is added, require exact Racket parity, all semantic witnesses, lesson identifiability, and a new negative-recombination probe before raising training suitability.
rationale: The repair achieves high input uniqueness through profile choice, D4 transforms, and distractor color permutations, but it does not attempt unconstrained procedural object morphology. That conservative scope avoids introducing unverified shapes while repairing the assigned defects.
summary: Synthetic variety is structural and role-aware but still template-based; independent monitor acceptance is required before reviewed-safe use.
